findings.highlight: The girl I admire so much is so close, yet I'm strangely calm.
findings.evidenceJa: こんなに近くに遠坂がいるのに、不思議と気持ちは落ち着いている。
findings.governingReading: He simply observes that Rin is this close yet he is strangely calm; the passage does not label his feeling as admiration.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s calm beside Rin becomes calm despite being beside “the girl I admire so much.”

findings.highlight: I felt like she wanted to ask me something
findings.evidenceJa: なんとなく聞かれたがってるな
findings.governingReading: Sensing that she wants the opening, Shirou prompts her to say what the conversation is about.
findings.explanation: Rin seeming to want Shirou to ask becomes seeming to want to ask him something.

findings.highlight: maybe you don't have to learn like that. I suppose, well, it might be you're just fine the way you are.
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮くんはそのままでもいいのかなって、ふと思った
findings.governingReading: The unusual house makes her reflect on others and question whether Shirou can safely remain in his present condition.
findings.explanation: Rin wondering whether Shirou is all right as he is becomes reassuring him that he need not learn differently and is fine as he is.

findings.evidenceJa: この屋敷はすごく自然なのよ。
findings.governingReading: Rin says the house feels extremely natural or unforced for a magus’s workshop and is unusually open.
findings.explanation: Rin describes the house as unusually natural and open for a mage’s workshop. “Naturalistic” describes imitation of nature, changing the word’s sense in this household contrast.

findings.highlight: I saw it coming a mile away.
findings.evidenceJa: そういうところが直球だって言ってるの
findings.governingReading: Shirou's claim that he copied Rin's indirectness itself bluntly criticizes her. Rin points to that very response as evidence of his directness.
findings.explanation: Rin originally points out that Shirou's defense itself proves how blunt he is. English makes her say the remark was predictable, changing the punchline.

findings.highlight: There is no bluster or lies that I can make out.
findings.evidenceJa: そこには強がりも偽りもなく
findings.governingReading: The narration affirms without qualification that she is neither putting on a brave face nor lying and is genuinely smiling with pleasure.
findings.explanation: Narration’s certainty that Rin’s smile contains no bluff or falsehood becomes only what Shirou can discern.

findings.highlight: I wouldn't do even that if wasn't fun.
findings.evidenceJa: それだって自分が楽しくなければやらないわ。
findings.governingReading: Even inheriting her father’s role is a duty she would refuse if she herself did not enjoy it.
findings.explanation: Rin’s statement of voluntary duty omits the subject in “if wasn’t fun.”

findings.highlight: I'm working with you because you're funny.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方が面白いからだし
findings.governingReading: She finds him an interesting person or case, consistent with curiosity and engagement rather than saying he makes her laugh.
findings.explanation: Rin cooperating because Shirou is interesting becomes cooperating because he is funny.

findings.highlight: But I guess I don't really have a clue about that sort of thing.
findings.evidenceJa: けれどそんなのはこっちの思いこみだ。
findings.governingReading: After Rin explains her chosen path, he explicitly retracts his projection that the Tohsaka lineage must weigh on her as a dark shadow.
findings.explanation: Shirou recognizing his burden narrative as his own assumption becomes claiming general ignorance about such matters.

findings.highlight: I suppose that would be the natural conclusion.
findings.evidenceJa: 当然のように遠坂は言う。
findings.governingReading: Rin assumes that Shirou must also have enjoyed training; the narration marks her manner as taking that conclusion for granted before Shirou cannot agree.
findings.explanation: Rin presenting her inference as obvious becomes Shirou endorsing it as the natural conclusion.

findings.highlight: her nail is digging into the tip of my nose!
findings.evidenceJa: 爪がこう、鼻の頭に触れてる
findings.governingReading: She crowds him so closely that the nail at the end of her pointing finger touches the tip of his nose.
findings.explanation: Rin’s fingernail touching Shirou’s nose becomes digging into it.

findings.highlight: as if smacking me with a glove.
findings.evidenceJa: 手袋を叩きつけるような口調
findings.governingReading: Her declaration sounds as though she is throwing down a glove as a formal challenge.
findings.explanation: Rin’s gauntlet-throwing tone becomes smacking Shirou with a glove.

findings.highlight: I was cornered and about to surrender
findings.evidenceJa: 降参しろと追い詰められた
findings.governingReading: During the school chase she drove him into a corner while telling him to give up, but Rider interrupted before any result.
findings.explanation: Rin cornering Shirou and demanding surrender becomes Shirou being about to surrender.

findings.evidenceJa: 首を洗って待ってなさい。
findings.governingReading: Rin uses an idiom meaning prepare for punishment; not knowing what she plans, Shirou wonders literally whether he should at least wash his neck.
findings.explanation: The “wash your neck and wait” threat and Shirou’s literal neck-washing response disappear.
